title: INSTALLATION OF ACTUATOR
ocr_text:
BR-64

BRAKE SYSTEM — Anti-lock Brake System (A.B.S.)

INSTALLATION OF ACTUATOR

1. INSTALL ACTUATOR
Install the actuator to the actuator bracket with three nuts and washers, and tighten them.
Torque: 55 kg·cm (48 in.·lb, 5.4 N·m)
HINT: Install the motor ground wire between the plate washer and spring washer before installing the rear right side nut.

2. CONNECT BRAKE TUBES TO ACTUATOR
Connect the brake tubes to the actuator by hand, and using SST, tighten them.
SST 09751-36011
Torque: 155 kg·cm (11 ft·lb, 15 N·m)

3. CONNECT ACTUATOR CONNECTORS
Connect the three connectors of the actuator.

4. FILL BRAKE RESERVOIR WITH BRAKE FLUID AND BLEED BRAKE SYSTEM

5. CHECK FOR FLUID LEAKAGE

6. CHECK ACTUATOR OPERATION
(See page BR-61)
